title: In __pkvm_load_tracing of trace.c, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to an incorrect bounds… (CVE-2026-58824)
description: CVE-2026-58824 is a vulnerability in the __pkvm_load_tracing function of trace.c caused by an incorrect bounds check leading to a possible out-of-bounds write. This flaw allows local escalation of privilege without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
